headline: RGC UPCOMING DEADLINE: Faruqi & Faruqi, LLP Reminds Regencell Bioscience (RGC) Investors of Securities Class Action Lawsuit Deadline on June 23, 2026
summary: Faruqi & Faruqi, LLP is reminding investors in Regencell Bioscience Holdings Limited (RGC) of the June 23, 2026 deadline to seek lead plaintiff status in a federal securities class action. The lawsuit alleges that Regencell and its executives made false and misleading statements by concealing the company's vulnerability to market manipulation and the resulting regulatory risks. The DOJ investigation was disclosed on October 31, 2025, causing RGC's share price to fall 18.56% on November 3, 2025.
